stance_rationale: Judge reached the directionally correct MONITORING_ONLY/non-promotion conclusion, but the draft is not finalizable because formal gates are softened by waiver language: true Harvey/DSR is absent, AX-008 is miscounted, covariance condition fails the requested bound, and lockbox/PIT lineage is incomplete.

scenario_rule_audit.replacement_evidence: WT is explicitly sizing_only/recommendation_only with planned GOVERNOR_REJECTED -> ABORTED and no production book_state write; Sequential Admission TDC was not applied.

statistical_robustness_audit.point_estimate_vs_robust_tradeoff: The reported 6.76 is Lo-style SR*sqrt(N/12), not the required 5-spec Newey-West Harvey gate; the reported DSR is a linear SR minus 0.35 proxy, not a real Deflated Sharpe Ratio. L-274 baseline was not given same 5-spec/DSR treatment.

critical_concerns.description: RF-J2/RF-J8 fail: Judge replaces mandatory Harvey-Liu-Zhu multi-testing evidence with a simple Lo t approximation and replaces DSR with SR minus 7*0.05. No CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, or FF6 Newey-West regressions are present.

AX-008 is miscounted: risk and optimizer Codex responses are absent or waived, forge Codex is REJECT, and Architect is not invoked, yet the tally converts timeouts/self-audits into PASS_CONDITIONAL. That is verification laundering, not 2-of-3 independent PASS.

covariance.parquet is PSD but fails the user-specified condition <=100 post-shrink check: 928 daily slices, no negative eigenvalues, but max condition is 240.87 and 13 dates exceed 100. Judge downgrading this to WARN as 'over-strict' is a silent constraint override.

PIT/schedule lineage is incomplete: user-specified qepm/stage_artifacts and stage_artifacts/WT_S20260504_002 paths do not exist, mailbox weights.csv is absent, alpha_scores.parquet is absent, and the available holdings are sleeve/cash placeholders rather than Date x Ticker stock-level weights.

RF-J3 lockbox audit is inconsistent with base context: base lockbox is sealed at 2024-01-23, but Judge evaluates 2025-01-01 to 2026-05-01 only and skips the judge lockbox harness. The 17-month slice may be useful, but it is not the full sealed lockbox boundary.

Benchmark audit claims PASS while benchmark returns are all zero and benchmark comparison metrics are blank/NA. This weakens any KR market-relative reading and should not be reported as benchmark_aligned PASS.

supporting_arguments: Judge correctly identifies the binding M4-relative failure: M4+DCC MDD -33.39% is worse than L-274 M4-only -32.05% by 1.34pp, so production promotion should not proceed.
No observed base hard fail: MDD is below the 45% hard cap and sleeve turnover is far below 600% annual.
AX-001 v2 is at least honestly marked PARTIAL_DEFENSE_LIKE with crisis alpha 3/3 positive but CRISIS alpha surrender of 1.55pp/month versus S1.
Weights schedule is multi-date at sleeve level: available root artifact weights.csv has 267 unique monthly dates and sleeve sum-to-one/long-only checks pass.
unresolved_disputes: Whether recommendation_only scope can formally waive true Harvey/DSR/5-spec evidence.
Whether condition <=100 applies to every covariance slice or only the final operational slice; the user request explicitly says covariance.parquet post-shrink condition <=100.
Whether sleeve-only proxy is acceptable without stock-level Date x Ticker weights and alpha_scores time-series evidence.
Whether lockbox should start at 2024-01-23 per base context or 2025-01-01 per this judge draft.
Whether the fixed 15% vol target is a mandated risk policy or a conservative heuristic requiring separate method-shopping penalty.
weakest_assumption: The most fragile claim is that recommendation_only/no book_state mutation allows formal validation failures to be downgraded into waivers or WARNs while still calling the judge package gate-complete.
rebuttal_required: Run 5-spec CAPM/Carhart-3/Carhart-4/FF5/FF6 Newey-West Harvey tests and a real DSR for M4+DCC and the M4-only baseline under identical candidate penalties.
Regenerate or shrink covariance.parquet so all slices satisfy condition <=100, or obtain an explicit user waiver for this bound.
Provide stock-level Date x Ticker x weight schedule and alpha_scores time-series evidence, or document a formal sizing_only exemption tied to immutable parent hashes.
Recompute lockbox metrics from 2024-01-23 sealed boundary, or justify the 2025-01-01 substitution with a written rule citation.
Correct AX-008 tally so timeouts, waived critiques, and REJECT stances are not counted as independent PASS sources.
rationalization_red_flags: fixed 15pct heuristic ceiling framed as not unilateral
WARN-level structural property used to dismiss condition >100

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: I agree with non-promotion/MONITORING_ONLY direction, but not with the draft's gate-complete framing. Independent verification sources are not sufficient because key Codex rounds are missing/waived and the one available forge Codex stance is REJECT.

judge_specific_questions: Replacement 시나리오에서 Sequential Admission 룰 적용 거부 evidence 있는가? Yes: recommendation_only/no book_state write, so TDC was not misapplied.
baseline의 Harvey gate FAIL 상태가 점 추정 SR 비교 신뢰도 약화시키는가? Yes: baseline has no same 5-spec Harvey/DSR treatment, so SR point-estimate comparison is not robust.
AX-001 v2 conditional metric이 defense 가설에 적용됐는가? Partially: crisis_alpha and alpha_surrender are reported, but self-fulfilling w_cash regime proxy remains unresolved.
